notablePrerequisites: You have no instants and/or sorceries in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's first ability triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
